channel.title: Letters from Oakakhi
channel.description: Guides and letters from Oakakhi Stays, Ranikhet.

item.title: Things to do in Ranikhet, the slow way
item.description: A local guide to the best things to do in Ranikhet, Uttarakhand: Kalika Temple, Chaubatia Gardens, Ranikhet Golf Course, Jhula Devi Temple, Bhalu Dam and Himalayan viewpoints.

item.title: Birdwatching in Ranikhet: the oak forest at dawn
item.description: A guide to birdwatching in Ranikhet and the Kumaon oak forests: Khalij pheasant, blue whistling thrush, red billed blue magpie, Himalayan bulbul, best season and tips.

item.title: Treks near Ranikhet, from forest walks to glaciers
item.description: The best treks near Ranikhet, Uttarakhand: Pandukholi, Bharatkot, the Mahavtar bamboo forest, and multi day treks to Pindari Glacier and Khalia Top, with local guides.

item.title: How to reach Ranikhet and Oakakhi
item.description: How to reach Ranikhet and Oakakhi Stays: by road from Delhi via NH 9, by train to Kathgodam, by air to Pantnagar, and parking near the homestay.

item.title: The best time to visit Ranikhet, season by season
item.description: When is the best time to visit Ranikhet? A season by season guide to weather, Himalayan views, stargazing, birdwatching and monsoon in Ranikhet, Uttarakhand.

item.title: A letter from the ridge: when the mist arrives
item.description: A letter from Oakakhi Stays in Ranikhet: monsoon mist in the oak forest, rain on the roof and slow days at a Kumaon homestay.
